title: Generate the next move from the failure evidence, not a lookup table
hypothesis: A hand-filled fallback table clears blocked steps as well as a loop that proposes moves from evidence and lets Jev rank them.
change: Replaced parents.json with gtme next-move: operators read the failure evidence, boundaries drop moves from data, Jev ranks, attempts land in the ledger.

oracle.baseline: old hard-coded chain cleared 2 of 5; one model call cleared 3 of 5

result: With both cost fixes built and agent moves still failing closed, the loop cleared 5 of 5 tuning blockers at 1.28 cleared per credit in 6 of 7 runs, against 2 of 5 at 1.18 for the old chain. On 2 held-out blockers frozen before the loop saw them it cleared 2 of 2 at 1.18; the old chain cleared 1 of 2 at 1.67 and one Codex call 2 of 2 at 1.18.
next_decision: Grade it on the next 10 real blockers; report cleared count next to cleared per credit, which favors a cheap miss.
check: When a step comes back empty, run gtme next-move plan on the evidence before adding any per-case fallback.
scope: Sabo brand-buyer chain and the Zeutara launch gate, replayed on 2026-10-16 from run logs

history.result: On 5 replayed blockers (4 Sabo, 1 Zeutara gate) with live Jev the loop cleared 5 of 5. Cleared per credit was 1.28 in 3 of 4 runs and 1.14 in 1, against 1.18 for the old chain, so per credit is a tie. With Jev off the loop cleared 2 of 5. These cases aren't held out: one cost fix was made after the first replay.
history.next_decision: Grade it on the next 10 real blockers before claiming it beats the old chain per credit.

history.result: After the break-it fix (agent moves classed from their action text, never their label) the loop cleared 4 of 5 replayed blockers at 0.91 to 1.03 cleared per credit, against 2 of 5 at 1.18 for the old chain. Zeutara's waiver ask now reads as a send and is dropped. More blockers cleared, worse per credit.
history.next_decision: Grade it on the next 10 real blockers; tune the send keywords only with a test that keeps every evasive phrase dropped.
